pages.title: Take the Scenic Route
pages.text: Discover a distinct natural landscape, then choose the next destination.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Walk into any one of the named biomes. The journal checks your actual location, not wood in your inventory. Its compass reward helps you search for the next biome.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Harvest Embedded Fish Fossil or its deepslate counterpart. Obtain fossil or jaw drops described by the installed item tooltip.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Explore Pale Gardens at night and trace a Creaking encounter to its heart-bearing Pale Oak. Discover the heart-controlled mob whose movement stops while observed.
